title: Campaign to Early Maps: Gearing and Crafting
summary: How to gear and craft your character from the campaign into early maps in Path of Exile 2: when to upgrade, how to use the crafting bench, which currency to use when, and how to prepare resistances and life for maps.
description: A gearing and crafting guide for Path of Exile 2 covering the campaign-to-maps transition: bench crafts, currency priority, and map-prep checklists.
prerequisites: A character progressing through the campaign
Basic access to the crafting bench in town
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

items.title: When should I upgrade gear?
body: Upgrade your weapon whenever your damage feels low and your armour/rings whenever you miss resistance or life targets. In the campaign, vendor and craft upgrades every few levels rather than waiting for a perfect drop.

items.title: What is the crafting bench for?
body: The bench adds specific, guaranteed modifiers (resistances, life, attributes, defences) to fill the gaps your drops do not cover. It is the cheapest way to cap resistances before maps.

items.title: Before maps, hit these
body: Cap all three elemental resistances at 75%, have a real life pool, and keep your weapon DPS high enough to clear comfortably. Maps punish incomplete gear harder than the campaign.

sections.title: Crafting currency reference
sections.caption: Which orb to use and when. Early game favours the cheap ones; save Exalted and Divine for maps and endgame rares.

cells.use: Adds a modifier to a magic item
Rerolls all modifiers of a rare
Adds one modifier to a rare

sections.note: A Regal Orb turns a magic item into a rare with one extra modifier - useful when you have a good magic base you want to keep.

sections.title: Campaign, bench, maps
sections.intro: The gearing loop has three phases. Pick yours.

tabs.label: Campaign gearing
paragraphs: Spend currency lightly and lean on the bench.
bullets: Use Transmutation + Augmentation on good bases, then fill gaps at the bench.
Upgrade your weapon first when damage drops; upgrade rings/chest for resistances.
Equip every resistance and life roll you find.

tabs.label: Bench crafts
paragraphs: The bench is your reliable, currency-cheap upgrade path.
bullets: Add a missing resistance (fire/cold/lightning) to hit 75% before maps.
Add life or attributes if a slot is short.
Use it on rares you plan to keep for several levels.

tabs.label: Map preparation
paragraphs: Before pushing tier, confirm your defenses.
bullets: Cap all three elemental resistances at 75%.
Hold a life pool and weapon DPS that clears comfortably.
Save Exalted/Divine for a real endgame rare, not a campaign stopgap.

sections.title: Bench craft examples
sections.intro: Typical bench crafts that solve common gaps:

cards.title: Resistance craft
body: Add a flat resistance to a ring, amulet, or chest to reach the 75% cap you are missing.

cards.title: Life craft
body: Add maximum life to a body armour or helmet when your pool is thin.

cards.title: Attribute craft
body: Add Strength, Dexterity, or Intelligence to meet a gem or gear requirement you are short on.

sections.title: My gear feels stuck
sections.intro: Select what is holding you back. The tool gives the fix.

rules.title: Upgrade weapon and links first
steps: A higher base-DPS weapon beats most passive points - upgrade it.
Finish your 6-link and level the main skill gem.
Use Alchemy/Chaos on a rare base with good tags if currency allows.

rules.title: Bench the missing resistance
steps: Use the crafting bench to add the specific resistance you lack.
Prioritise reaching 75% on all three elements before maps.
Move resistances onto gear so passive points can go to damage.

rules.title: Bench or farm more life
steps: Craft maximum life onto your biggest armour slots.
Prefer gear with an implicit or roll that includes life.
A thin pool is the main cause of one-shot deaths in maps.

rules.title: Craft the attribute you need
steps: Add the missing attribute on a ring or amulet via the bench.
Or respec one passive point into the attribute node.
Meeting attribute requirements unlocks higher gems and gear.

defaultResult.title: General gear plan
steps: Cap resistances with the bench, grow life, keep weapon DPS high, and save top currency for endgame rares.
Upgrade in small steps every few levels instead of waiting for a perfect drop.
Watch the referenced gearing and crafting guides for a full visual walkthrough.

items.question: Should I use Exalted Orbs in the campaign?
answer: Usually no. Save Exalted and Divine for maps and endgame rares. In the campaign, Transmutation, Augmentation, Alchemy, and bench crafts get you further per orb.

items.question: How do I cap resistances without good drops?
answer: Use the crafting bench to add the specific resistance you are missing on rings, amulets, or your chest. It is the cheapest, most reliable path to 75%.

items.question: When is my character ready for maps?
answer: When all three elemental resistances are at 75%, you have a comfortable life pool, and your weapon DPS clears campaign bosses without struggle.
